name: get_campus_agenda
description: Query confirmed Campus agenda events by inclusive date range, course, or comma-separated kinds. Use this for the next class or dated events; if one day is empty, widen the range instead of substituting the recurring weekly schedule. Includes live-clock academicContext. Use referenceWeek and explicit section labels before choosing current materials; use referenceDate for a future class. calendar_unavailable requires verifying and recording a program calendar, not assuming week 1.

forceRefresh.description: Queue a metadata-only refresh while returning the last good cache.

referenceDate.description: Optional target class date for material matching; does not replace the current server date.
